from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != background]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != background]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    regions = [(row_bounds[i]+1, row_bounds[i+1], col_bounds[j]+1, col_bounds[j+1])
               for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1) for j in range(len(col_bounds)-1)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    source_region = next((box for box in regions if any(
        grid[r][c] != background for r in range(box[0], box[1]) for c in range(box[2], box[3]))), None)
    if source_region is None:
        return out
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = source_region
    pattern = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1)] for r in range(r0, r1)]
    for a, b, x, y in regions:
        if (b-a, y-x) != (r1-r0, c1-c0):
            continue
        for dr in range(b-a):
            for dc in range(y-x):
                if pattern[dr][dc] != background:
                    out[a+dr][x+dc] = pattern[dr][dc]
    return out
'''
file_path = program_dir / 'task-15c25221.py'
file_path.write_text(source)
print(file_path)
